Customer Service Representative Job at the Palace Workers




        
    

        
        The Palace Workers, a third party recruiting for a hospitality company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Representative

Job Location: Ogba - Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Providing in formation on product and services to prospective and new customers.
	Handling customer complaints and troubleshooting issues with products or services.
	Following up with clients or customers by phone, web chat or email to check that they’re still satisfied with their purchases or services received.
	Accessing databases to retrieve account information for customers.
	Letting customers know about additional products or services that might benefit them.
	Escalating queries and concerns when necessary.
	Updating customer records following each contact.
	Staying up to date on the latest products and services theorganization provides.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send a copy of their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Outlet Supervisor (Male) Job at J3 Holdings




        
    

        
        J3 is an FMCG distributor. We have been in existence over 8 years. J3 has branches in several locations; Lagos, Ibadan, Ogun, Ondo, and Osun states.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Outlet Supervisor (Male)
Job Location: Mushin, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

PostJob Openings

 

Job Description
Marketing Strategy & Planning:
     

            
    




	Develop and implement FMCG marketing strategies aligned with company sales and growth objectives.
	Analyze market trends, consumer insights, and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
	Manage annual and quarterly marketing plans, calendars, and budgets.


Brand & Product Management:


	Manage brand positioning, product visibility, and shelf presence.
	Support new product development, launches, relaunches, and packaging updates.
	Ensure consistent brand messaging across all platforms and regions.


Trade Marketing & Distribution Support:


	Design trade promotions to support distributors, wholesalers, and retailers.
	Work closely with sales teams to improve product availability, merchandising, and visibility.
	Develop POS materials (banners, shelf talkers, flyers, standees, in-store branding).


Consumer & Promotional Marketing


	Plan and execute consumer promotions, discounts, sampling, activations, and roadshows.
	Coordinate below-the-line (BTL) activities to drive volume sales.
	Monitor promotion effectiveness and recommend improvements.


Digital & Media Management:


	Oversee digital marketing including social media campaigns, online ads, and content creation.
	Coordinate media planning, buying, and public relations activities.
	Track campaign performance using KPIs and market data.


Team & Vendor Management:


	Supervise marketing executives, field marketers, and brand promoters.
	Manage relationships with advertising agencies, printers, media houses, and vendors.
	Ensure timely delivery and quality of marketing materials.


Reporting & Performance Analysis:


	Prepare regular marketing and market performance reports.
	Measure ROI on marketing spend and trade promotions.
	Use data insights to optimize future marketing activities.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a relevant qualification with experience.


Salary
N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the email. 

Note: For more information, contact on WhatsApp 09152781100.

  "title": "Wealth Manager",
  "description": "Advancly Technologies Nigeria Limited is a financial technology business, that builds economies by partnering with global aggregators and investors to connect African entrepreneurs with affordable financing, to scale their businesses.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Wealth Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

About the Role


	We are looking for a results-driven, articulate, and strategic Wealth Manager to join our dynamic team.   "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Senior Mechanical Resident Engineer (MEP Supervision)",
  "description": "Contemporary Group Limited (CGL) is a leading group of companies offering a full range of services in the construction industry. CGL is a dynamic leader in the construction value chain, made up of Contemporary Design Associates, Contemporary Properties Limited, Conwave Ventures Limited, and Contemporary Ventures and Resources Limited. With the vision to be a unique solution provider for exceptional projects and a determination to lead innovation and sustainability in the industry, CGL has completed over 200 projects in more than three decades.

CGL is a group of Architects, Engineers, Estate Surveyors, Valuers and Property Developers managing one-off building assignments, to the coordination of large scale integrated projects. With its team of dynamic and seasoned professionals the group has been able to establish itself as one of the foremost property development companies in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Mechanical Resident Engineer (MEP Supervision)

Job Location: Victoria Island / Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Job Summary


	Acts as the client&rsquo;s technical representative on-site, supervising and auditing the mechanical contractors&#39; installations (HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, and drainage).
	Leverages a minimum of 10 years of deep engineering experience (including hands-on contractor-side execution) to critically review shop drawings, audit material quality, and detect contractor deviations or cost-inflations.
	Ensures the entire mechanical scope of the project is delivered strictly according to design specifications, international engineering codes, and Lagos state regulatory frameworks.
